scenarios.name: a child sees only their own monitoring profile and cannot change it; an adult sees and configures every profile

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_wellness_check_in__profiles (id, member_id, label, active, interval_hours, message, recipient_member_ids, recipient_emails, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('pa', ?, 'A daily', 1, 24, 'Please check on A', '[]', '[]', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'), ('pb', ?, 'B daily', 1, 24, 'Please check on B', '[]', '[]', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
SELECT id FROM app_wellness_check_in__profiles
UPDATE app_wellness_check_in__profiles SET active = 0 WHERE id = ?
SELECT id FROM app_wellness_check_in__profiles ORDER BY id
UPDATE app_wellness_check_in__profiles SET interval_hours = 12 WHERE id = ?
SELECT id, active, interval_hours FROM app_wellness_check_in__profiles
